To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Maine Freedom of Access Act, I hereby request the following records:

To minimize staff research time and allow for a simple electronic search, I have strictly narrowed the scope of this inquiry by providing the exact search parameters needed.

Please provide the following records created, sent, or received between March 26, 2026, and November 10, 2026:

Targeted Individuals (Custodians):

Town Manager Michelle Flewelling

Fire Chief Travis Leary

Any other town employees with responsibilities related to the delivery, oversight, or contracting of fire and/or EMS services

Accounts to be Searched:
This request applies to official town email accounts as well as any personal, private, or alternative email accounts used by the targeted individuals to receive, send, or forward emails pertaining to town business, as defined by 1 M.R.S. section 402(3).

Specific Search Parameters to be applied to the accounts above:

Domain Search: All emails (and their attachments) sent to or received from any email address ending in the domain @deltaambulance.org.

Maine EMS Contact Email Search: All emails (and their attachments) sent to or received from any of the following Maine EMS email addresses:

maine.ems@maine.gov

ems.licensure@maine.gov

wil.oneal@maine.gov

jason.j.cooney@maine.gov

jason.a.oko@maine.gov

marc.a.minkler@maine.gov

melissa.f.adams@maine.gov

Keyword Search: All emails (and their attachments) sent or received by the targeted individuals containing any of the following exact keywords or phrases:

"Delta Ambulance"

"ambulance"

"EMS"

"Emergency Medical Services"

"Delta"

"paramedic"

"EMT"

As defined by 1 M.R.S. section 402(3), public records include any matter, regardless of physical form, in the possession or custody of an agency or public official that has been received or prepared for use in connection with the transaction of public or governmental business. This explicitly includes communications stored on personal devices or personal email accounts if they pertain to town business.

I also request that, if appropriate, fees be waived as we believe this request is in the public interest, as suggested but not stipulated by 1 M.R.S.A. § 408(6). The requested documents will be made available to the general public free of charge as part of the public information service at MuckRock.com, and is not made for commercial usage.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

MuckRock
